locale.description: The code of this translation's language (e.g. de, pt_BR), used as the settings page's lang attribute. Not shown.

extName.description: Extension name, shown in the browser and the extension stores. Translate it so it reads naturally and stays short.

extDescription.message: Adds physics to HTML elements in the current tab for fun.
extDescription.description: Extension description, shown in the browser and the extension stores.

badgeOn.description: Badge on the toolbar icon while physics is on. At most 4 characters; it has very little room.

restorePage.description: Button shown on the page while physics is on; clicking it puts the page back to normal. Also used in other messages below, so keep them consistent.

escKey.description: Label of the Escape key, as printed on keyboards. Shown as a key hint next to the Restore page button.

physicsOnStatus.message: Physics is on. Press Escape or Restore page to turn it off.
physicsOnStatus.description: Read aloud by screen readers when physics turns on (not shown).

physicsOnNote.message: Shaking your browser window turns on physics. Press Restore page or Esc to turn it off.
physicsOnNote.description: Note shown under the Restore page button the first time physics turns on, explaining what happened.

settingsPageTitle.description: Browser tab title of the settings page.

settingsHeading.description: Main heading of the settings page.

physicsSettings.description: Heading of the settings group that controls how pieces move.

gravityHint.message: At 0 the page stays a flat tabletop. Raise it to make pieces fall.

airDrag.description: Setting name: air resistance on moving pieces.

airDragHint.message: How quickly thrown pieces slow down.

bounce.description: Setting name: how bouncy pieces are.

bounceHint.message: How much pieces bounce off each other and the edges of the window.

frictionHint.message: How much pieces 'catch' when they slide past each other.

weight.description: Setting name: how heavy pieces are.

dragStrength.description: Setting name: how firmly a grabbed piece follows the mouse pointer.

dragStrengthHint.message: How tightly a piece follows your pointer.

shakeSettings.description: Heading of the settings group that controls what counts as shaking the browser window.

shakeDistanceField.description: Screen reader name of the Minimum shake distance number field.

shakeDistanceHint.message: How far the window has to move before changing direction to count as one shake.
shakeDistanceHint.description: Explains the Minimum shake distance setting.

shakeSpeed.description: Setting name, measured in pixels per second.

shakeSpeedField.message: Minimum shake speed in pixels per second
shakeSpeedField.description: Screen reader name of the Minimum shake speed number field.

shakeSpeedHint.message: How fast the window has to move for a shake to count, so slow moves don't set it off.
shakeSpeedHint.description: Explains the Minimum shake speed setting.

shakesNeeded.description: Setting name: how many shakes turn physics on.

shakesNeededHint.message: How many shakes it takes to start.

timeToShakeField.description: Screen reader name of the Time to shake number field.

timeToShakeHint.message: How quick the $count$ shakes have to happen to trigger the physics.
timeToShakeHint.description: Explains the Time to shake setting. $count$ is the current Shakes needed value (2 to 10) and updates as it changes.

hideRestoreButtonHint.message: Hides the restore page button that appears in the top-right corner when physics is on.
hideRestoreButtonHint.description: Explains the Hide Restore page button setting. In right-to-left languages the button is in the top-left corner instead, so say top-left there.

unitPx.description: Abbreviation for pixels, shown after a number.

unitPxPerSecond.description: Abbreviation for pixels per second, shown after a number.

unitMs.description: Abbreviation for milliseconds, shown after a number.

valuePx.description: A setting's value as read aloud by screen readers.

valuePxPerSecond.description: A setting's value as read aloud by screen readers.

valueMs.description: A setting's value as read aloud by screen readers.

tipStart.message: Grab the window by its title bar and shake it, OR click the extension icon.
tipStart.description: Tip on the settings page: how to turn physics on. May contain only the tags <strong>, <i> and <kbd>.

tipRestore.message: Press Esc, click the Restore page button, OR click the extension icon to restore the page.
tipRestore.description: Tip on the settings page: how to turn physics off. May contain only the tags <strong>, <i> and <kbd>.

resetSettings.description: Button that puts every setting back to its default.

resetConfirm.message: Reset all settings to their defaults?
resetConfirm.description: Confirmation dialog after clicking Reset to defaults.

resetFailed.message: Couldn't reset the settings. Try again.
resetFailed.description: Error dialog if resetting the settings failed.

resetDone.description: Read aloud by screen readers after the settings are reset (not shown).
